_meta.provenance: Shape and field names: real. Guest data: fake. Token: fake (the real one is crypto.randomUUID()).
_meta.note: A post-midnight arrival (time 00:00 to 03:00) must be sent with reserved_at set to the NEXT calendar date, or with date already advanced. The date+time path does not apply slotDateStr. The website form does (BookingForm.tsx:264-265).

replayOfSameIntentKey.cause: same intent_key and same details sent again after a lost response
replayOfSameIntentKey.note: The first booking comes back. The venue is not notified a second time (public-reservations.ts:262-268).

afterwards.meaning: This is a request. The venue confirms or declines later; the guest is told by email only if an email address was given.
